basic_details.job_title: GMC Jalna Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 20 Professor, Associate Professor and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Government Medical College, Jalna is filling 20 teaching posts on contract: 6 for Professor, 2 for Associate Professor and 12 for Assistant Professor, across 15 medical subjects. Applicants need an MD, MS or DNB in the subject and must be citizens of India living in Maharashtra. You hand the filled form in person at the college office by 5.00 pm on 12 November 2026, and interviews take place on 17 November 2026. The monthly consolidated pay is Rs. 1,00,000 to Rs. 2,00,000, depending on the post.

application_fee.details: The fee is Rs. 200/- for each application. You need a separate application for each post you apply for.

age_limit.details: Professor and Associate Professor: below 70 years. Candidates from private and other sectors can apply if they hold the qualifications prescribed by the National Medical Commission (NMC). Assistant Professor: 40 years for the open category and 45 years for backward classes. This follows Government Resolution MES-1508/94/08/MED dated 07.09.2011 and the NMC notifications of 14.02.2022 and 30.06.2025.

qualification.details: Professor and Associate Professor: below 70 years. Candidates from private and other sectors can apply if they hold the qualifications prescribed by the National Medical Commission (NMC). Assistant Professor: 40 years for the open category and 45 years for backward classes. This follows Government Resolution MES-1508/94/08/MED dated 07.09.2011 and the NMC notifications of 14.02.2022 and 30.06.2025. | You must be a citizen of India and a resident of Maharashtra. | An MD / MS / DNB postgraduate qualification in the subject, or an equivalent postgraduate qualification, from a recognised university. You must also be qualified under the norms of the Maharashtra Medical Council and the National Medical Commission, New Delhi (as per the notification of 30.06.2025). Registration under the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956, and valid registration with the Maharashtra State Medical Council under the 1965 Act. A certificate showing you have completed BCME and BCBR training, as per NMC norms. | Professor: 4 national and international research papers in total, 2 of them written while serving as Associate Professor (NMC notification of 30.06.2025). Associate Professor: 2 national and international research papers written while serving as Assistant Professor. | Professor: at least 3 years as Associate Professor in a medical college that is eligible under NMC norms. Associate Professor: at least 4 years as Assistant Professor in a medical college that is eligible under NMC norms. Assistant Professor: 1 year as Senior Resident. The subject table puts this as 1 year as Senior Resident or Tutor in the subject, in a recognised medical institution. | A postgraduate MD/MS/DNB degree in the subject, as per the notifications of 14.02.2022 and 30.06.2024. You should have completed the basic course in biomedical research, or be required to undergo it. You should have completed the basic course in Medical Education Technology from an NMC-designated institution, or be required to undergo it. | For the full subject-wise eligibility of each post, see the official notification.

how_to_apply: Download the blank application form from www.gmcjalna.org. It is available from 29 October 2026 to 12 November 2026.

Write the post you are applying for and fill in your details: name in capital letters, postal address, mobile number, email ID, date of birth, age, caste category, internship completion date, whether you are bonded or non-bonded, registration number, and up to three subject preferences.

Give your UG and PG qualifications (year of passing, college, university, M.M.C./M.C.I. registration with date), your aggregate marks in final M.B.B.S. and in the PG degree or diploma, and the number of attempts you took for each M.B.B.S. year.
List your research papers (national or international year of publication, first or second or corresponding author, indexing) and your teaching experience with dates.
Paste a photograph, sign the declaration and attach attested copies of your documents.
Hand in the application in person at the inward section of the Government Medical College, Jalna office by 5.00 pm on 12 November 2026. Public holidays are excluded.
Date of birth certificate / S.S.C. School Leaving Certificate

content_sections.heading: About GMC Jalna
content_sections.text: Government Medical College, Jalna is a Maharashtra Government medical college. It works under the Commissioner, Medical Education, Research and AYUSH, Mumbai, and the Directorate of Medical Education and Research, Mumbai. Its address is Global Gurukul School, opposite Sushiladevi Lawn, Ambad Mantha Road, Jalna - 431213. Its phone number is 02482-299907.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is Rs. 200/- for each application. You need a separate application for each post you apply for.

rows.event: Last date to hand in the form

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected through the Departmental Selection Board and the Local Selection Board, by interview. The interview starts at 11.00 am sharp on 17 November 2026 in the Dean's chamber at Government Medical College, Jalna. You must bring the originals of every document you attached to your application. You travel to the interview at your own cost, and no allowance is paid. For Professor and Associate Professor, the college accepts the applications, interviews the candidates and then sends the eligible candidates' applications to the Commissioner, Medical Education and Research, Mumbai, for the appointment process.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointments follow Government Resolution LEC-2024/Pr.Kr.181/Vaiseva-3 dated 21 August 2024 and Government Resolution MES-1508/94/08/MED dated 07.09.2011.

faq.question: Q1. Which subjects have Assistant Professor vacancies at GMC Jalna?
faq.answer: There are 12 Assistant Professor posts: Anatomy 2, Biochemistry 2, Pharmacology 2, and 1 each in Physiology, Medicine, Skin & VD, ENT, Anaesthesiology and Radiology.

faq.question: Q2. Can I send the application by post or email?
faq.answer: No. You must hand in the filled form in person at the inward section of the college office, Global Gurukul School, opposite Sushiladevi Lawn, Ambad Mantha Road, Jalna - 431213.

faq.question: Q3. How much fee do I pay if I apply for two posts?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 200/- per application, and you apply separately for each post. Two posts means two applications, at Rs. 200/- each.

faq.question: Q4. What experience do I need for the Professor post?
faq.answer: At least 3 years as Associate Professor in an NMC-eligible medical college. You also need 4 national and international research papers, 2 of them from your time as Associate Professor.

faq.question: Q5. Do I need to be from Maharashtra?
faq.answer: Yes. You must be a citizen of India and a resident of Maharashtra, and you attach a domicile certificate with your form.

faq.question: Q6. Can I resign partway through the contract?
faq.answer: Not before the end of at least one academic session after your appointment. You must give an affidavit to this effect before you are appointed.

faq.question: Q7. What should I bring to the interview on 17 November 2026?
faq.answer: The originals of every document you attached to your application. The interview starts at 11.00 am sharp in the Dean's chamber, and no travel allowance is paid.

faq.question: Q8. Which training courses must Assistant Professor candidates have?
faq.answer: The basic course in biomedical research and the basic course in Medical Education Technology from an NMC-designated institution. You should have completed them or be required to undergo them.

faq.question: Q9. Will this contract post become permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment gives no claim to a regular post. It lasts 364 days or until a regular candidate is available, whichever comes first.
